title: Beef in Beer in the Slow Cooker
description: Delicious tender beef is cooked in the slow cooker with beer - Guinness® no less - shallots, bacon, and mushrooms for a hearty dinner.
ingredients: 4 teaspoons vegetable oil, divided, or as needed
1 (12 fluid ounce) can or bottle Irish stout beer (such as Guinness®)
2 onion, cut in half and sliced
4 slices smoked streaky bacon, sliced into strips
salt and ground black pepper to taste

steps.text: Heat 2 teaspoons oil in a skillet over medium-low heat and cook shallots until they are lightly browned, 5 to 10 minutes. Place in the slow cooker. Add beef to the same skillet and cook until meat is seared on all sides and browned, about 5 minutes. Add flour and mix well. Pour in beer and bring to a boil. Transfer beef-beer mixture to the slow cooker.

Wipe out the skillet with a paper towel and add remaining 2 teaspoons oil. Add onion and cook until soft and translucent, about 5 minutes. Add garlic and bacon and cook for 1 minute more. Transfer to the slow cooker. Add mushrooms and season generously with salt and pepper. Cover.
Cook on Low until meat is cooked through, about 5 hours.
